title: Breaded {Protein} tacos with tartar sauce
source: Love & Lemons (Jeanine Donofrio), adapted, Breaded & Baked Artichoke Fish Tacos
steps: Whisk the ground flaxseed into the almond milk and let it sit 5 minutes until it thickens into a slurry — this is the binder that replaces egg.
In a second bowl combine GF panko, hemp seeds, smoked paprika, salt, and pepper. Note the original called for onion powder here; the smoked paprika covers it.
{PROTEIN_PREP} Dip each piece in the flax slurry, then press firmly into the GF panko mixture.
{PROTEIN_COOK} Or air fry at 400°F for 12 minutes, flipping once and spritzing with oil.
Toss the shredded red cabbage with lime juice, olive oil, salt, and pepper. Ten minutes is enough.
{STARCH_REHEAT} Fill each with tartar sauce, cabbage, protein, thin radish, serrano if you want heat, and cilantro. Lime to finish.
kid: Breaded and crispy with a dipping sauce is the whole appeal. Skip the serrano and serve the cabbage on the side.
note: The breading loses its crunch fast. Bread it Sunday, bake it the night you eat it.
